run_boostbuild_test_project_root_rule: run the BoostBuild test that verifies a Jamroot rule can be called from a child Jamfile to declare a target
write_jamroot_with_glob_rule: write a jamroot.jam file that declares a project with static linking and a my-lib rule using glob for source files
write_sub_jamfile: write a subdirectory jamfile.jam that invokes the my-lib rule to build a library target
run_build_system_in_subdir: run the BoostBuild build system in a subdirectory to compile sources and produce a library artifact
expect_addition_and_cleanup: assert that the expected library file was created in the build output directory and clean up test artifacts
